changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: hold FIX and turn a knob to link that parameter to velocity.
Hold SAMPLER and turn a knob to link it to aftertouch.
While held, linked knobs show their amounts like performance locks.
Uses the sound's own four velocity and four aftertouch slots, so links save with the kit.
A FIX tap now toggles fixed velocity when you let go.
